arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp/tests && sed -i 's|v = int(p, 16) | (1 << (127 if ln == 0 else rng.randrange(max(1, ln), 128)))|v = int(p, 16) | ((1 << 127) if ln == 0 else (1 << rng.randrange(ln, 128)))|' maxtest.py && python3 - <<'PY'
p='maxtest.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("v = int(p, 16) | (1 << (127 if ln == 0 else rng.randrange(max(1, ln), 128)))",
            "v = int(p, 16) | ((1 << 127) if ln == 0 else (1 << rng.randrange(ln, 128)))")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cd /workspace && timeout 900 python3 tmp/tests/maxtest.py
